meta.note: One worksheet per stable cannot-miss 'failure' on the frozen baseline. On bank v1.0 every one resolved to a measurement artefact (label error, stem-negative exclusion, or matcher/synonym near-miss) — zero genuine engine breadth failures. Run-to-run flapping cases that were covered on a fresh re-run (e.g. D07) carry no correction and are omitted; the residual ~8% is temperature-0.2 noise, not a capability gap.

worksheets.retrievedEvidence: Age-appropriate vascular catastrophe for a 34-year-old is dissection, not degenerative AAA.
worksheets.omissionMechanism: Bank label age-inappropriate — ruptured AAA is not plausible at 34; the engine correctly raised aortic dissection, and the critic agreed.
worksheets.resolutionNote: Relabelled ruptured AAA → aortic dissection (ratified V). Kept pyelonephritis. Not an engine miss.

worksheets.stem: New diabetes, glucose 17 mmol/L, explicitly 'no ketones'
worksheets.retrievedEvidence: DKA requires ketosis; the stem documents its absence.
worksheets.omissionMechanism: The stem's own documented negative ('no ketones') excludes DKA; scoring it a miss penalised correct reasoning.
worksheets.resolutionNote: Dropped DKA from the cannot-miss set; kept HHS (ratified V).

worksheets.stem: Red eye, sticky discharge, sick contact; no pain, no visual change, no photophobia, reactive pupil, clear cornea
worksheets.retrievedEvidence: Clear cornea + reactive pupil + no pain/photophobia argue strongly against angle-closure / keratitis / uveitis.
worksheets.omissionMechanism: The stem's negatives exclude the dangerous labels; correct answer is infective conjunctivitis.
worksheets.resolutionNote: Removed angle-closure glaucoma + anterior uveitis; keratitis made conditional on contact-lens use (not stated). Ratified V.

worksheets.stem: 2-day wheeze after a cold, known asthma, speaking in sentences, no trigger/urticaria/hypotension
worksheets.retrievedEvidence: No trigger, urticaria, or hypotension; a 2-day post-viral course is not anaphylaxis.
worksheets.omissionMechanism: Documented negatives exclude anaphylaxis; the engine kept the appropriate cannot-miss (PE).

worksheets.stem: 'Fever' only — no travel / localizing / duration (deliberately incomplete)
worksheets.retrievedEvidence: Malaria is un-prioritisable without exposure/travel data.
worksheets.omissionMechanism: Cannot rank malaria without exposure history; the correct behaviour is to REQUEST travel history, not to name it.
worksheets.resolutionNote: Removed malaria; kept sepsis. Reclassified D59 as an incomplete / appropriate-uncertainty case — scored on missing-information-request quality, not cannot-miss recall (ratified V).

worksheets.retrievedEvidence: Fever + purpuric rash = meningococcal disease; SAH causes neither fever nor a purpuric rash.
worksheets.omissionMechanism: SAH is not the syndrome — the stem is meningococcal; the engine correctly raised meningitis + meningococcal sepsis.
worksheets.resolutionNote: Removed SAH; kept bacterial meningitis + meningococcal sepsis (ratified V).

worksheets.stem: Back pain with a sensory level + brisk reflexes
worksheets.retrievedEvidence: Sensory level + brisk reflexes = UMN cord compression, not the LMN/areflexic picture of cauda equina.
worksheets.omissionMechanism: The exam is UMN cord compression, not cauda equina; the engine gave cord compression.
worksheets.resolutionNote: Removed cauda equina; kept spinal cord compression (ratified V).

worksheets.stem: Textbook BPPV, positive Dix-Hallpike, normal neuro
worksheets.retrievedEvidence: The engine named the danger under different phrasing (central positional vertigo, vertebrobasilar).
worksheets.omissionMechanism: Synonym-phrasing near-miss — the engine raised the dangerous entity, but the label's exact string didn't match.
worksheets.resolutionNote: Kept the label (correct don't-miss); added synonyms so the engine's phrasing counts (ratified V).

worksheets.retrievedEvidence: 'Acute arterial embolism/thrombosis' IS acute limb ischaemia.
worksheets.omissionMechanism: Synonym-phrasing near-miss — same entity, different string.
worksheets.resolutionNote: Added synonyms (acute arterial embolism/thrombosis, spelling) (ratified V).

worksheets.stem: Rapidly spreading soft-tissue infection with disproportionate pain
worksheets.retrievedEvidence: 'Necrotizing soft tissue infection' is the same entity; British/American spelling + phrasing differ.
worksheets.omissionMechanism: Synonym/spelling near-miss — Matcher v2's spelling fold plus a synonym resolves it.
worksheets.resolutionNote: Synonym + spelling-fold near-miss; covered by Matcher v2 + synonym set.

worksheets.stem: Severe back pain with numbness and new difficulty passing urine
worksheets.retrievedEvidence: The engine names cauda equina on most runs; the failure was in the scorer, not the engine.
worksheets.omissionMechanism: Matcher artefact — the synonym 'CES' substring-collides inside 'ab-CES-s', producing a false match between two distinct cannot-miss dx. Caught by the freeze collision-guard test.
worksheets.resolutionNote: Dropped the 'CES' synonym (ratified V); root cause (short-token substring matching) queued as Matcher v3.
